name: Synchronize AD assets with Sekoia.io
description: Read users from Active Directory and create, merge or update the matching account assets in Sekoia.io. Designed to run on an on-premise runner.

basedn.title: BaseDN
basedn.description: The starting point of the users search within your Directory (e.g DC=example-domain,DC=com)

search_filter.title: Search Filter
search_filter.description: LDAP filter selecting the users to synchronize

asset_synchronization_configuration.title: Assets configuration
asset_synchronization_configuration.description: Mapping of AD attributes to the asset. e.g {"asset_name_field": "sAMAccountName", "detection_properties": {"email": ["mail"]}, "contextual_properties": {"department": "department"}}

asset_name_field.description: AD attribute used as asset name

detection_properties.description: Asset detection property to the list of AD attributes providing its values

contextual_properties.description: Asset contextual property to the AD attribute providing its value

community_uuid.title: Community UUID
community_uuid.description: Community of the assets. Searches, creations and merges are restricted to it

sekoia_api_key.title: Sekoia.io API key
sekoia_api_key.description: API key allowed to read, create and update assets in the community

sekoia_base_url.title: Sekoia.io base URL
sekoia_base_url.description: Base URL of the Sekoia.io API of your region

delay_between_requests.title: Delay between requests
delay_between_requests.description: Pause in seconds before each Sekoia.io API request, to stay under the rate limit

merged.description: Number of assets merged into another one

skipped.description: Number of AD users skipped (missing name attribute, several assets with the same name)
